statements.statement: The patient has a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
There is concern for an underlying cardiac arrhythmia as the potential embolic source
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered
The service was intended to capture intermittent events over an extended period
The service was intended to identify paroxysmal arrhythmias missed during standard office evaluations
The diagnosis codes billed were I49.9 and G45.9
The denial reason code was CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
